indoor/beds/boheme.description_en: Upholstered bed featuring a wooden headboard and bed frame with polyurethane foam padding. Headboard frame made of metal tubing in a bronzed brass or gold-plated brass finish, upholstered in leather. Upholstery available in various leather and fabric categories from the collection. Feet and metal details in a bronzed brass finish.
materials: Headboard and bedframe: fabric A/B, leather C/D
Details: bronzed brass, gold finished brass

indoor/bookcases/asia.description_en: Double-sided modular bookcase, suitable for wall mounting or as a freestanding room divider, with vertical metal uprights in bronzed brass and polished steel finishes or upholstered in leather. Shelves upholstered in leather with a perimeter edge in bronzed brass
